title: gen2 behavioral diagnosis
finding: gen2 learned efficient foraging (+53% seeds vs the scripted survivor) but not hiding: 0.3% of threatened time in shelter vs 22% for the survivor; caught in 70% of episodes vs 47%. Held-out survival plateaued after ~14M steps.
cause_hypothesis: Discovery problem, not a reward bug: meadows were placed >= 2.2 u from any shelter edge in a 24x16 world, so the payoff of hiding is delayed and rarely experienced.
change: World v2.1.0 (meadows 2-4 u from a shelter edge; stalking audible at 2.5 u) and a fresh lineage gen3 from random weights. No reward for hiding was added.
